name: reduced_motion_fallback
principle: Every choreographed effect needs a static, equally complete state.

name: scroll_choreography
principle: Tie motion to scroll position, never to elapsed time, so users stay in control.
avoid_when: Task surfaces, long-form reading, low-power devices.

name: bento_composition
principle: Vary tile weight to encode importance while keeping a single grid rhythm.
avoid_when: Ordered/sequential content, or when tiles have equal weight.

name: persistent_sidebar
principle: Keep global navigation always reachable when users pivot between many peer sections.
use_when: 5+ top-level destinations, repeat-visit tooling, desktop-first workflow.

name: three_d_product_focus
principle: 3D earns its cost only when rotation/inspection is the message.
avoid_when: Decorating a page that could ship as an image.

name: dense_data_table
principle: Maximise scannable rows per viewport; align numerals right, use tabular figures.
use_when: Comparison and scanning across many records is the primary job.
avoid_when: Fewer than ~8 records, or the record itself is the destination.

name: ambient_shader_background
principle: Keep ambient motion below conscious attention: low contrast, low velocity, pausable.
use_when: Brand surfaces needing depth without content competition.
avoid_when: Text-heavy or data-heavy regions; battery-constrained contexts.

name: bottom_tab_navigation
principle: Put 3-5 primary destinations inside thumb reach.
use_when: Mobile app-like surfaces with flat IA.

name: hero_value_proposition
principle: One claim, one proof, one action; everything else is below the fold.

name: kpi_summary_row
principle: Answer 'is anything wrong?' above the fold before offering detail.
avoid_when: Exploratory analytics where no single metric is canonical.

name: progressive_disclosure
principle: Reveal depth on demand so the default view stays legible.
avoid_when: Users need side-by-side comparison of the hidden fields.

name: subtle_hover_elevation
principle: Confirm affordance with the smallest perceivable change (<=4px, <=150ms).
avoid_when: Touch-only contexts, where hover never fires.
